comment: He may know math but he does not know how to teach it. He has few office hours and is not helpful even if you attend them. His intro level course is impossible and he knows this but does not seem to care.

Dr. Anderson gets complains even from math majors. Despite the fact that he is brilliant at statistics, even 119, an intro level Stats class, is extremely difficult. He does not explain things well and his homework is impossible. Do not expect an A.

Anderson is a brilliant person, but he is a very poor professor. He doesn't know how to explain things to people. Unless you have a very solid comprehension of the class BEFORE you take it, you will have a REALLY hard time passing. He confused people who knew what he was supposed to be teaching and curved everyone's final grades to make up for it.
